items.headline: Price move coincides with 1 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 6328.93/MWh on 2026-07-14, same day as: TORANGALLU TPS unit 3: 300.0 MW affected (~300 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
